description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks related to the Views module, including help text, pre-render processing, theme suggestions, entity and block hooks, query alterations, and configuration updates.

classes.name: ViewsHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hooks for the Views module, including help, pre-render, theme suggestions, entity and block hooks, query modifications, and configuration updates.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information for the Views module, including module description, documentation links, and accessibility features.

methods.name: viewsPreRender
methods.description: Pre-render hook for Views, attaching AJAX settings and libraries if AJAX is enabled.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsNodeAlter
methods.description: Alters theme suggestions for nodes based on associated views, including deprecated suggestions.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsCommentAlter
methods.description: Alters theme suggestions for comments based on associated views, including deprecated suggestions.

methods.name: themeSuggestionsContainerAlter
methods.description: Alters theme suggestions for container elements, especially 'more_link' elements with views.

methods.name: fieldConfigInsert
methods.description: Clears views data cache upon insertion of field configuration entities.

methods.name: fieldConfigUpdate
methods.description: Clears views data cache upon update of field configuration entities.

methods.name: fieldConfigDelete
methods.description: Clears views data cache upon deletion of field configuration entities.

methods.name: baseFieldOverrideInsert
methods.description: Clears views data cache when base field override entities are inserted.

methods.name: baseFieldOverrideUpdate
methods.description: Clears views data cache when base field override entities are updated.

methods.name: baseFieldOverrideDelete
methods.description: Clears views data cache when base field override entities are deleted.

methods.name: formViewsExposedFormAlter
methods.description: Hides certain form elements in Views exposed forms for security or UI simplification.

methods.name: queryViewsAlter
methods.description: Alters Views queries tagged by Views, replacing substitutions in tables and conditions.

methods.name: localTasksAlter
methods.description: Modifies local tasks for Views using the ViewsLocalTask plugin.

methods.name: viewPresave
methods.description: Updates view configuration before saving using ViewsConfigUpdater service.

methods.name: blockPresave
methods.description: Adjusts block settings before saving, especially for views blocks, and triggers deprecation warnings.
